# A13-S36: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Thank you so much for this message, which made me really happy and relieved
. I have also received the pictures from [████] now with an explanation of the graphic
 choices, and I actually also think that they are super cool! And then I also
saw that there are both collages and individual pictures, which I’m
totally down with, and think it’s cool that you fixed the resolution. I definitely want to
focus on giving [████] good luck and credit, because he is
super skilled.

I was just very surprised to see it on LinkedIn and not in
my mailbox, because I think there had been good dialogue about it. And at
that time I didn’t know why the various choices had been
made, which just triggers all sorts of speculations and confusion.
Which made me totally dizzy after [████]’s response.

So yes, I am on board, and really looking forward to our events. And
I am really, really happy about your message here.

Moreover, I obviously understand well that misunderstandings can arise when working across the country. I strive to be as thorough and careful as possible, here while everything is moving so fast, and I’m also working around the clock to get it out among people and promote our agenda. As I also said right at the beginning, I really want it to be a joint project, so that it can contribute to creating a special identity and history around MindFuture as a wild and visionary workplace.








It will be good to gather people at the weekend. This conference has gone
really well, and I have engaged a lot of wise and interesting researchers
in the project, which we will presumably be able to draw on in different
contexts moving forward.

All the best, [████]
